browser_test_sequence: Deploy R7/R7B frontend source with generated runtime client ID config.
Open Profile page signed in to APC.
Confirm GoogleSync panel appears only on Profile.
Confirm no backend DB or queue write occurred for this proof.
do_not: Do not commit a real Google OAuth client ID into repository source.
Do not request broad Drive scope.
Do not store access tokens in localStorage.
Do not run this from Study, Companion, Admin, or global navigation.
Do not write APC personal study data to Drive in this proof.
google_cloud_requirements: Drive API enabled in the Google Cloud project.
OAuth consent configured for the app.
OAuth client type is Web application.
Authorized JavaScript origin includes the deployed origin, such as https://alexhartel.com.
Test users are added while the app is in testing mode, if applicable.
rollback: Remove or disable the generated runtime client ID config script.
Revert index/script injection if one was added during deploy.
Use Profile rollback button to delete the harmless test file.
If needed, manually delete files named APC GoogleSync Dev Proof from Drive.
